name: Walker in Rust — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Walker in Rust from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Walker in Rust" but are not part of the Walker in Rust entry, which is unchanged.

Special: An urban druid, wizard of the Metal school, cleric with the Artifice domain, or technokineticist can select this feat without meeting the above prerequisites.

Kineticists who do not possess prepared spells can only use this feat with their spark of life wild talent.

In addition to the plethora of innate abilities a kineticist has access to, there are several tools they can use to enhance their own powers, and some that can benefit from their abilities.
